rendered: The document does not give a UV–vis limit of detection (LOD) for E. coli. It reports UV–vis LODs only for P. aeruginosa and L. monocytogenes, each compared with the CD value, and says CD always reached a lower LOD than UV–vis. For P. aeruginosa, the LOD was[1] OD600 =0.0034[2] by CD versus 0.0066 (UV–vis, Fig. S17b)[3]. For L. monocytogenes, it was 0.0123 (CD, Fig. S17c) versus 0.0125 (UV–vis,[4] Fig. S17d). E. coli appears in the concentration-discrimination tests in Fig. 3[5], but no LOD is given for it.
